meshy-dev-meshy-3d-agent-meshy-3d-genera.description: Create or edit digital 3D assets with Meshy: models, textures, rigging, animation, and reference images. For physical printing, use meshy-3d-printing.

meshy-dev-meshy-3d-agent-meshy-3d-printi.description: Generate or prepare models for physical 3D printing, including white or multicolor prints, Creative Lab products, sizing, and slicer handoff.

meshy-dev-meshy-3d-agent-meshy-openclaw.description: Create 3D models, textures, reference images, rigging and animation with Meshy, and prepare models for physical 3D printing: white or multicolor prints, Creative Lab products, sizing and slicer handoff. Drives the Meshy CLI; signs in through the browser, no API key required.
